title: Hydrocarbons
keyIdea: A hydrocarbon is a compound made of hydrogen and carbon atoms only. Size, double bonds and rings do not matter; one atom of any other element, such as oxygen or chlorine, means it is not a hydrocarbon.

kid: A hydrocarbon is made of just two kinds of atom: hydrogen and carbon. The name tells you: hydro for hydrogen, carbon for carbon.
Methane, CH₄, is a hydrocarbon. Its formula has only C and H in it. Octane, C₈H₁₈, is one too. It is in petrol.
Ethanol, C₂H₅OH, has C and H, but it also has an O. That one oxygen atom means it is not a hydrocarbon. The key word is only.
A compound needs both C and H to count. CO₂ has no H. H₂ has no C. Neither of them is a hydrocarbon.
adult: A hydrocarbon is a compound that contains carbon and hydrogen atoms and nothing else. To test a formula, list its element symbols. If the list is exactly C and H, it is a hydrocarbon.

The test ignores size and shape. Methane, CH₄, and octane, C₈H₁₈, are hydrocarbons. So are propene, C₃H₆, which has a C=C double bond, and benzene, C₆H₆, a ring. Crude oil is mostly a mixture of hydrocarbons.
Many carbon compounds are not hydrocarbons. Ethanol, C₂H₅OH, and glucose, C₆H₁₂O₆, contain oxygen. Chloromethane, CH₃Cl, contains chlorine. Carbon dioxide, CO₂, has no hydrogen at all.

Common mistakes: calling any compound with C and H a hydrocarbon and forgetting the word only; thinking a double bond or a ring rules a molecule out; and treating every carbon compound, or hydrogen gas, H₂, as a hydrocarbon.

familyTip: Read the ingredients or chemical names on a few labels at home, such as a gas bottle (propane or butane), a candle, nail polish remover (propanone) or vinegar (ethanoic acid). Look up each formula and decide together: only C and H, or something else too?

worked.title: Which of CH₄, C₂H₅OH and C₃H₆ are hydrocarbons?
steps: List the elements in each formula. CH₄: C and H. C₂H₅OH: C, H and O. C₃H₆: C and H.
A hydrocarbon has C and H only, so check each list for anything else.
C₂H₅OH has an O, so it is not a hydrocarbon, even though it has C and H.
CH₄ and C₃H₆ are hydrocarbons. The double bond in C₃H₆ does not matter.

practice.prompt: Which of these is a hydrocarbon?
choices: C₃H₈
C₂H₅OH
CO₂
practice.hint: List the element symbols in each formula. Which list is only C and H?
practice.explain: C₃H₈, propane, has only C and H. C₂H₅OH also has O, and CO₂ has no H.

practice.prompt: A list has {n} formulae. {a} of them contain only C and H. Each of the rest also contains O or Cl. How many are NOT hydrocarbons?
practice.hint: One extra element is enough to fail the test. Count the formulae that are not C and H only.
practice.explain: Only the {a} with C and H alone are hydrocarbons, so {n} − {a} = {=n-a} are not.

practice.prompt: A hydrocarbon has {c} carbon atoms and {h} hydrogen atoms in each molecule. How many atoms are in one molecule?
practice.hint: A hydrocarbon has only two kinds of atom. Add the two counts.
practice.explain: Carbon and hydrogen are the only atoms, so {c} + {h} = {=c+h} atoms in one molecule.

practice.prompt: Propene, C₃H₆, has a C=C double bond. Is it a hydrocarbon?
choices: Yes, its atoms are only carbon and hydrogen
No, hydrocarbons have only single bonds
No, it has too few hydrogen atoms
practice.hint: The definition is about which kinds of atom are present, not how they are bonded.
practice.explain: Only the elements matter. C₃H₆ is carbon and hydrogen only, so it is a hydrocarbon, double bond and all.

practice.prompt: Why is glucose, C₆H₁₂O₆, not a hydrocarbon?
choices: It contains oxygen as well as carbon and hydrogen
It is too big a molecule
It has no carbon atoms
practice.hint: Read every element symbol in the formula, not just the first two.
practice.explain: Glucose has 6 O atoms. Any element besides C and H means it is not a hydrocarbon, whatever its size.

choices: A compound of hydrogen and carbon only
Any compound that contains carbon
A compound of hydrogen and oxygen
pool.hint: The name is built from two element names. The key word is only.
pool.explain: A hydrocarbon contains hydrogen and carbon atoms and nothing else. Many carbon compounds contain other elements too.

pool.prompt: Sam says C₂H₅OH is a hydrocarbon because it contains carbon and hydrogen. What is wrong?
choices: It also contains oxygen, so it is not carbon and hydrogen only
Nothing, Sam is right
It has too many carbon atoms
pool.hint: Read the formula to the end. Is there a symbol that is not C or H?
pool.explain: The O in C₂H₅OH is an oxygen atom. A hydrocarbon has C and H only, so ethanol is not one.

pool.prompt: Which of these is NOT a hydrocarbon?
choices: CH₃Cl
C₆H₆
C₂H₄
pool.hint: Look for a symbol that is neither C nor H.
pool.explain: CH₃Cl, chloromethane, has a chlorine atom. Benzene, C₆H₆, and ethene, C₂H₄, are carbon and hydrogen only.

pool.prompt: Is carbon dioxide, CO₂, a hydrocarbon?
choices: No, it has no hydrogen and it contains oxygen
Yes, it contains carbon
Yes, all carbon compounds are hydrocarbons
pool.hint: A hydrocarbon needs both carbon and hydrogen, and nothing else.
pool.explain: CO₂ has no H at all and has O, so it fails the test twice. Containing carbon is not enough.

pool.prompt: A list has {n} formulae. {k} of them contain oxygen and the rest contain only carbon and hydrogen. How many are hydrocarbons?
pool.hint: Any formula with oxygen in it fails the test. Take those away from the total.
pool.explain: The {k} with oxygen are not hydrocarbons, so {n} − {k} = {=n-k} are.

pool.prompt: Cyclohexane, C₆H₁₂, is a ring of six carbons. Is it a hydrocarbon?
choices: Yes, a ring is fine as long as the atoms are only C and H
No, hydrocarbons must be straight chains
No, rings always contain oxygen
pool.hint: The test is about which elements are present, not the shape.
pool.explain: Shape does not matter. C₆H₁₂ is carbon and hydrogen only, so it is a hydrocarbon.

pool.prompt: Is hydrogen gas, H₂, a hydrocarbon?
choices: No, it has no carbon, and it is an element
Yes, it is made of hydrogen
Yes, it burns like methane
pool.hint: Check for both elements in the name hydro-carbon.
pool.explain: H₂ is the element hydrogen. With no carbon it is not a compound of C and H, so it is not a hydrocarbon.

pool.prompt: Crude oil is mostly a mixture of what?
choices: Hydrocarbons
Carbohydrates such as glucose
Carbon dioxide and water
pool.hint: Petrol, diesel and the gas in a camping stove all come from it.
pool.explain: Crude oil is mostly hydrocarbons of many sizes. Carbohydrates such as glucose contain oxygen, so they are not hydrocarbons.

pool.prompt: Propane, C₃H₈, is a hydrocarbon. How many atoms are there in {n} molecules of propane?
pool.hint: Read the formula: 3 carbon atoms and 8 hydrogen atoms in each molecule, and nothing else.
pool.explain: Each molecule has 3 + 8 = 11 atoms, so {n} molecules have 11 × {n} = {=11*n} atoms.

visual.caption: Hydrocarbon or not? Check every element symbol: carbon and hydrogen only. Drag each card, or tap it and then tap a box.

lab.caption: Flagship lab: scan the atoms in each molecule, watch the element tally build up, then sort it: hydrocarbon or not?
